title: Probe orchestration and evidence

authorized_handoff.heading: ## Probe migration coordination, proposed fifteenth core family

milestones.acceptance: Versioned metadata, profile receipts and session records validate required identity and nonce linkage, schema/version, path roles and exact error/refusal order; missing, stale, conflicting and duplicate evidence is refused.
milestones.initial_zero_reason: No verified Go admission contract or owner-approved synthetic receipt oracle.

milestones.acceptance: Deterministic event/cohort reports preserve native slots, exact fingerprints, ordered evidence, warm/cold distinctions and unknown outcomes across fixed-field, narrative, positional-grid, code/hook/capacity and image-state comparisons. SKIPPED and UNKNOWN outcomes retain their reasons and source ordering and never count as passing coverage.
milestones.initial_zero_reason: Existing offline reports do not establish probe event semantics or original scenario cohort parity.

milestones.acceptance: Build/session-bound typed memory reads and decoders match owner oracles and refuse stale/partial/malformed/unsupported reads. Versioned diagnostic hook/counter plans, saved/live provenance and material displaced-instruction/ABI obligations are independently verified.
milestones.initial_zero_reason: Static Go hook/template facts are partial support only; no complete owned diagnostic/read pipeline or ABI proof.

milestones.acceptance: Serialized captures tie frame tags, decoded UI, image paths, logs and checkpoint outcome to one process/session; timeout, partial and cross-session/race cases are preserved/refused; owner-operated native comparison confirms parity. Bounded evidence retention and resource budgets are agreed with the probe owner and verified, including stalled/partial capture behavior.
milestones.initial_zero_reason: No verified Go capture pipeline or owner-exported exact capture contract.

milestones.acceptance: Exact PID/starttime/build/ISO, profile receipt, PINE, virtual-pad, IPC/session/nonce and private card roots govern lifecycle and cleanup. Warm reset differs from cold restart; preservation/post-flush hashes and adversarial ownership refusals pass under one controller owner. BIOS/card/controller identities are guarded. Unattended crash/stall detection, bounded recovery, safe stop/resume and post-flush preservation pass under owner-agreed limits. Bounded skip/attempt policy preserves SKIPPED/UNKNOWN outcomes without granting coverage or unbounded polling/retries.
milestones.initial_zero_reason: No verified Go lifecycle replacement; existing Python remains operational owner.

milestones.acceptance: Exact-source smoke and three sequential stories, nondefault slot creation/paired reload, preservation/overwrite/retry, verified advancement and broader required cohorts pass; independent acceptance authorizes one-owner handover without duplicate production FSM. Starting the story probe and leaving it unattended requires owner-agreed bounded soak duration, recovery outcomes, resource and evidence-retention acceptance. These limits remain TBD; prior three-story tests do not establish this acceptance.
milestones.initial_zero_reason: Current-actor takeover fresh smoke/stories remain pending in authorized handoff; no verified Go scenario parity or handover.

diagnostic_instrumentation.retain: Versioned hook/counter preparation, saved/live provenance, displaced-instruction/ABI gap including duties outside save/reload.

runtime_platform.retain: Transport, input, capture/inspection, exact owned lifecycle.

runtime_scenarios.retain: Fixed-field, narrative, positional-grid, code/hook/capacity and image-state comparisons.

initial_metrics.meaning: Unweighted accepted capabilities/checklist groups, not effort, time or reuse percent.

gates: Wait for root-provided final art checkpoint baseline identity; do not stage from a guessed live head.
Create isolated taxonomy/doc staging only after prior checkpoint is finalized and source pins verified.
Keep current Python runtime owner until identical native acceptance; no second production state machine.
Peer-reviewed sanitized synthetic fixtures and stable export/refusal contract precede future implementation.
Taxonomy changes do not grant code/native capability, historical retirement or ISO/control authority.

current_authorized_handoff.heading: ## Probe migration coordination, proposed fifteenth core family
current_authorized_handoff.qualification: Authorized coordination section only. Current section adds bounded skipped-eligibility bookkeeping and reports 98 tests plus57 subtests. Owner-reported results were not rerun here. Fresh current-actor production smoke/three stories and preservation/overwrite retry remain pending at this source freeze.

user_unattended_acceptance.requirement: Starting the story probe, leaving it unattended, and all lifecycle/recovery responsibilities are inside the full probe family.
user_unattended_acceptance.duration: TBD with probe owner before acceptance; no invented overnight duration.
user_unattended_acceptance.recovery_and_resource_budget: Owner-agreed bounded detection, recovery, safe stop/resume and resource/evidence budgets must be explicit acceptance criteria.

implementation_gate: Receive owner-approved public-safe synthetic metadata/profile/session/receipt/events schemas and refusal-order fixtures before Go parsing implementation. Existing Python remains sole production owner until identical native acceptance and explicit one-owner handover.
